name: BetterTouchTool
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For BetterTouchTool, map trackpad, mouse, keyboard, and window gestures to explicit local actions. The hard boundary is huge input-device coverage, scripting depth, community presets, and os maintenance, plus os integration polish and maintenance.
